ALPINE RESEARCH SERVICES — PROCUREMENT CONTROL POLICY
Effective date: 1 July 2026

Total commitment                  Required evidence
Up to and including CHF 10,000    One written quotation
Above CHF 10,000 through
CHF 50,000 inclusive              Three independent quotations and Finance approval

A documented emergency may waive the quotation requirement only when CFO approval is recorded. Related orders placed within a rolling 30-day period shall be aggregated. Orders must not be split to avoid a threshold. A purchase may not be released when its total commitment exceeds the approved available budget.

This text is a synthetic operational fixture. It is not an actual company policy.
